title: The Glass Garden
explanation: Behind Bahar's clock shop lies a garden no one knows of — made of glass and of time.
content:
Every clock showed a different hour, and Bahar was not troubled by it at all. “Each clock tells its own story,” she would say to Mira, wiping a dusty face.

The garden lay beyond the door at the back of the shop. As she stepped inside, the glass leaves chimed softly, as though they recognised the visitor.

Time did not flow there. It only gathered, like light in a jar.
